name: TaskToAgent - n8n error alert + nightly backup

parameters.content:
## n8n error alert + nightly backup
**Alerts:** paste your Discord webhook in **Post to Discord**, save, then in EACH workflow you care about: Settings > Error workflow > pick this one. (Alerts fire for production runs, not manual tests.)

**Backup:** Settings > n8n API > create a key, add it as an n8n credential in **Get all workflows**. Every night all workflows go into one file, /home/node/.n8n-files/n8n-backup-DATE.json (self-hosted only; create the folder once: `mkdir -p ~/.n8n-files`, n8n 2.x only writes inside it).

Want git history + push to GitHub? Use the Python version (backup mode). Activate.
